about: Did they improve? Part 3 (decision models): the frozen cohort, the open human choices and the money switches. A human answer changes this file, never the code. Cohort: Ümit #3744 (the 8) and #3746 (Base Labs Elephant-1 added), one row per model at its leaderboard setup. Source: mailbox/Did they improve - decision models - addendum 2026-11-09.md (rows and reasons), v3.db players.settings (route, model id, parameters), v3.db league replies (allowed response ids).

D1_empty_runs.status: proposed default; Ümit may change (separate | shared)

D5_edge_settings.status: proposal pending Ümit: Base Labs past the trained 16,384 tokens (Elephant-1: notes arm; Mammoth-1: both arms) and REAX's read-twice -> read-once switch eligible with a page note (pending | eligible | not_tested)

D6_hosted_allowance_usd.status: approved by Ümit (native message 1569386890212147201, relayed Zeki #3753): hosted spending outside OpenRouter counts within the existing $110 total cap (the $5 OpenRouter reserve and the 1.5x per-model rule unchanged); 110 = no allowance beyond the $110 total. $0 would refuse every billed call of that provider.

decision_lane_cap_status: hard allocation of the decision lane within the $110 (Zeki #3772): every decision provider, the writer and the probes, open reservations and open allocations included; the chat lanes' share is $107 (runs/share_cap.json), so $107 + $3.00 = $110

amendments.source: Ümit native 1570509348072063026 (every Tiny and Small model tested on Logic & Math), via Zeki #5674/#5689; priority and cash directive native 1570507658425933987
amendments.note: Added after the addendum was published: every Tiny and Small decision model tested on Logic & Math (Base Labs Elephant-1 was already in the cohort). Same rule, arms, test and schedule; each local route still needs its render check (§6.1) and the response ids of its own league replies (§3). The notes arm's writer is paid and waits for Ümit's approval of the cash batch. A model with no league record is listed as not started.

setups.delivery_flag: delivery unverified (our evidence gap): Liquid's docs neither publish a limit nor say that oversize input is refused rather than cut; a result is shown with this flag and never as verified delivery
setups.limit_source: documented 32,768 tokens, refused with 422 above (read 2026-11-12, no call): https://docs.liquid.ai/api/reference/decision-models/make-decisions (OpenAPI /api/openapi.json, POST /decisions/v1/systemone, questions): 'the input limits apply to the state, images, and one question together: `d1` and `d1.1` allow 65,536 tokens and `d1-ultra` 32,768, and all three 250 KB of text, and they return 422 over either'; https://docs.liquid.ai/api/models: d1-ultra context window 32,768; OpenRouter metadata GET /api/v1/models/liquid/d1-ultra/endpoints: context_length 32768
